property_summary: The transfer function always returns true when it completes without reverting.
For any inputs, transfer always succeeds (does not revert) on the reference, but on the mutant it reverts when the inner call succeeds.
After any call to transfer, the return value is always true.
The call to c.transfer returns true for any inputs that satisfy the preconditions.
The reference C always returns true from transfer(); the mutant can return false because an inner success causes require(!_s) to revert, so the return is never reached when revert occurs.
The reference C's `transfer` function never reverts for any valid inputs, while the mutant reverts when the inner call succeeds because it requires `!_s`.
